### McGraw Hill, Inc. to Host Investor Day on November 18, 2026


September 14, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/964897494/files/doc_news/McGraw-Hill-Inc--to-Host-Investor-Day-on-November-18-2026-2026.pdf)


COLUMBUS, Ohio--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[McGraw Hill, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2F&esheet=54602377&newsitemid=20260914747405&lan=en-US&anchor=McGraw+Hill%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=8dd9a4d5956830e8c772c587794e4495) (NYSE: MH), a leading global provider of education solutions for preK-12, higher education and professional learning, today announced that it will host an Investor Day on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, in New York City. The event will be in person and webcast and will begin at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time and conclude at approximately 12:30 p.m. Eastern Time.


The event will be hosted by Philip Moyer, President, Chief Executive Officer; Dave Cortese, Executive Vice President, Chief Digital Information Officer; and Bob Sallmann, Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, as well as other members of McGraw Hill’s executive leadership team.


Executives will discuss McGraw Hill’s strategic priorities, growth initiatives, technology roadmap and financial framework. The event will also feature interactive product demonstrations and educator discussions and will conclude with a live question and answer session.


Due to limited space, in-person attendance will be invite-only with prior registration required. To access the live webcast or to view a replay of the event, please visit the Company's investor relations website at[https://investors.mheducation.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.mheducation.com%2F&esheet=54602377&newsitemid=20260914747405&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.mheducation.com%2F&index=2&md5=1ec99469ee13bd4b1149c14940c777c8) .


**McGraw Hill** McGraw Hill (NYSE: MH) is a leading global provider of education solutions for preK-12, higher education and professional learning, supporting the evolving needs of millions of educators and students around the world. We provide trusted, high-quality content and personalized learning experiences that use data, technology and learning science to help students progress towards their goals. Through our commitment to fostering a culture of innovation and belonging, we are dedicated to improving outcomes and access to education for all. We have over 30 offices across North America, Asia, Australia, Europe, the Middle East and South America, and make our learning solutions available in more than 80 languages. Visit us at[mheducation.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2F&esheet=54602377&newsitemid=20260914747405&lan=en-US&anchor=mheducation.com&index=3&md5=aabf386ede666638e73a63f75e72ec0f) or find us on[Facebook](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fmcgrawhilleducation&esheet=54602377&newsitemid=20260914747405&lan=en-US&anchor=Facebook&index=4&md5=f14d586d3820611802909509d8e2c301) ,[Instagram](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fmheducation%2F%3Fhl%3Den&esheet=54602377&newsitemid=20260914747405&lan=en-US&anchor=Instagram&index=5&md5=5fc669ea1429262b3331614924c16cb3) ,[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fmcgraw-hill-education%2F&esheet=54602377&newsitemid=20260914747405&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=6&md5=7b346d6918687459f8e15897455c02d2) or[X](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2Fmheducation&esheet=54602377&newsitemid=20260914747405&lan=en-US&anchor=X&index=7&md5=4d94dd83340d13de7dfb10a68a324a50) .
